forecast_error.title: Forecast error by lock and jornada (a graded run; latest by default)
forecast_error.sql:
SELECT from_j, jornada, ahead, n, round(rmse, 3) AS rmse, round(bias, 3) AS bias,
       round(top50, 2) AS top50_scored, flagged_n, round(flagged_rmse, 3) AS flagged_rmse,
       round(flagged_bias, 3) AS flagged_bias
FROM grade_error WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) AND (nullif(:ahead, '') IS NULL OR ahead = :ahead)
ORDER BY from_j, jornada

forecast_error_by_ahead.title: Forecast error by how far ahead: mean of each jornada's error; flagged players pooled
forecast_error_by_ahead.sql:
SELECT ahead, count(*) AS forecasts, round(avg(rmse), 3) AS rmse,
       sum(flagged_n) AS flagged_n,
       round(sqrt(sum(flagged_rmse * flagged_rmse * flagged_n) / sum(flagged_n)), 3) AS flagged_rmse,
       round(sum(flagged_bias * flagged_n) / sum(flagged_n), 3) AS flagged_bias
FROM grade_error WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) GROUP BY ahead ORDER BY ahead

error_by_value.title: Where the forecast misses, by value (:run, default the latest graded with plays; :ahead, the fewest jornadas past the lock, default 1): players in quarters of value at the lock forecast from, cheapest first; the chance he plays against how often he did, and the points when he played, forecast against scored. bias = forecast minus scored per player-jornada
error_by_value.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast WHERE plays IS NOT NULL)) AS run_id),
l AS (SELECT jornada AS from_j, (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM market WHERE observed_at <= rl.lock) AS at FROM round_locks rl),
v AS (SELECT l.from_j, m.ff_id AS player, ntile(4) OVER (PARTITION BY l.from_j ORDER BY m.value, m.ff_id) AS q
      FROM l JOIN market m ON m.observed_at = l.at WHERE m.ff_id <> ''),
played AS (SELECT DISTINCT player, jornada FROM squad_minutes WHERE mins > 0 AND player IS NOT NULL),
g AS (SELECT g.*, v.q, p.player IS NOT NULL AS went FROM grade_forecast g JOIN r USING (run_id)
      JOIN v USING (from_j, player) LEFT JOIN played p ON p.player = g.player AND p.jornada = g.jornada
      WHERE g.jornada - g.from_j >= cast(coalesce(nullif(:ahead, ''), 1) AS INTEGER)
        AND g.jornada IN (SELECT jornada FROM jornadas_done))
SELECT q AS value_quarter, count(*) AS n, round(avg(plays), 3) AS plays_forecast, round(avg(went), 3) AS played,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN went THEN predicted / plays END) / sum(went), 2) AS points_forecast_when_played,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN went THEN actual END) / sum(went), 2) AS points_when_played,
       round(avg(predicted - actual), 2) AS bias
FROM g GROUP BY q ORDER BY q

persistence.title: Persistent share of a player's expectation (what PERSISTENT_SHARE is measured by)
persistence.sql:
SELECT persistent_share FROM persistence_by_run
WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast))

decisions_graded.title: Replayed boards: each funnel outcome's forecast against what happened
decisions_graded.sql:
SELECT reached, kind, count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN jornadas > 0 THEN pred / jornadas END), 2) AS forecast_per_jornada,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN jornadas > 0 THEN real / jornadas END), 2) AS happened_per_jornada,
       round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN jornadas > 0 THEN real > 0 END)) AS happened_up_pct,
       round(100 * avg(chance)) AS forecast_chance_pct,
       round(avg(value_pred), 2) AS value_forecast_m, round(avg(value_real), 2) AS value_happened_m
FROM grade_decisions WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_decisions))
GROUP BY reached, kind
ORDER BY CASE reached WHEN 'plan' THEN 0 WHEN 'cleared' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, kind

plan_moves_graded.title: Every move a replayed board planned, against what happened
plan_moves_graded.sql:
SELECT lock, move, round(pred, 1) AS forecast, round(real, 1) AS happened, jornadas,
       round(value_pred, 1) AS value_forecast_m, round(value_real, 1) AS value_happened_m
FROM grade_decisions WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_decisions)) AND reached = 'plan' ORDER BY ord

compare_grades.title: Two graded runs' next-jornada forecasts, on the players both forecast
compare_grades.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT a.from_j, a.jornada, a.player, a.predicted AS pa, b.predicted AS pb, a.actual
           FROM grade_forecast a JOIN grade_forecast b USING (from_j, jornada, player)
           WHERE a.run_id = :a AND b.run_id = :b AND a.from_j = a.jornada),
     r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jornada ORDER BY pa DESC, player) AS ra,
                     row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jornada ORDER BY pb DESC, player) AS rb FROM p)
SELECT jornada, count(*) AS n,
       round(sqrt(avg((pa - actual) * (pa - actual))), 3) AS rmse_a,
       round(sqrt(avg((pb - actual) * (pb - actual))), 3) AS rmse_b,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN ra <= 50 THEN actual END), 2) AS top50_a,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN rb <= 50 THEN actual END), 2) AS top50_b
FROM r GROUP BY jornada ORDER BY jornada

timings.title: Runs: seconds by stage, rows parsed, memory
timings.sql:
SELECT r.run_id, r.started, r.trigger, r.commit_sha, r.ok, round(r.peak_mb) AS peak_mb,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'parse' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS parse_s,
       max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'parse' AND m.measure = 'snapshots' THEN m.value END) AS snapshots,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'crosswalk' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS crosswalk_s,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'sim' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS sim_s,
       round(max(CASE WHEN m.stage = 'grade' AND m.measure = 'seconds' THEN m.value END), 1) AS grade_s
FROM runs r LEFT JOIN run_measures m USING (run_id)
GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY r.run_id DESC LIMIT 100

funnel.title: Every move the latest board ranked: gain, confidence, verdict, plan
funnel.sql:
SELECT rank, label, round(gain, 1) AS gain, round(100 * p_better) AS better_pct,
       round(per_million, 2) AS per_million, round(cost / 1e6, 2) AS cost_m, verdict, in_plan
FROM funnel WHERE run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM funnel))
  AND (nullif(:name, '') IS NULL OR label LIKE '%' || :name || '%') ORDER BY rank

offers.title: The game's offers for your players (latest run), the best price first: the offer against his value, the share of the game's last offers it beats, what selling him does to your season in points, and whether the plan sells him
offers.sql:
SELECT name, pos, round(offer / 1e6, 2) AS offer_m, round(value / 1e6, 2) AS value_m,
       round(100 * (offer / value - 1), 1) AS vs_value_pct, round(100 * beats) AS beats_pct,
       round(gain, 1) AS season_points, sell
FROM board_mine WHERE offer IS NOT NULL AND value > 0 ORDER BY offer / value DESC, player

market.title: The market as the latest run ranked it: every player on sale whose purchase gains you season points, the bid it takes, the share of seasons you are better off, and why it fails the bar (empty: worth buying)
market.sql:
SELECT name, pos, round(asking / 1e6, 2) AS asking_m, round(bid / 1e6, 2) AS bid_m,
       round(gain, 1) AS season_points, round(100 * p_better) AS better_pct, verdict, in_plan AS plan,
       round(trend, 1) AS trend_pct, round(resale / 1e6, 2) AS resale_m
FROM board_buys WHERE gain > 0 ORDER BY rank

why_sell.title: Why these sales: every sale of yours ranked by points lost per million raised; the plan takes the cheapest that clear the debt (a balance below zero at the lock scores nothing)
why_sell.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM sim_runs)) AS run_id),
me AS (SELECT max(0.0, -cash) AS debt FROM sim_standings JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE me),
s AS (SELECT f.rank, substr(f.label, 6) AS player, f.proceeds AS raises, f.gain, f.per_million, f.in_plan
      FROM funnel f JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE f.kind = 'sell')
SELECT player, round((SELECT debt FROM me) / 1e6, 1) AS debt_m, round(raises / 1e6, 1) AS raises_m,
       round(gain, 1) AS season_points, round(per_million, 2) AS points_per_m,
       round(sum(raises) OVER w / 1e6, 1) AS raised_so_far_m,
       round(max(0.0, (SELECT debt FROM me) - sum(raises) OVER w) / 1e6, 1) AS debt_left_m,
       (SELECT debt FROM me) > 0 AND raises >= (SELECT debt FROM me) AS covers_alone, in_plan
FROM s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY per_million DESC, rank) ORDER BY per_million DESC, rank

forecast.title: A player's forecast, factor by factor (latest run)
forecast.sql:
SELECT f.jornada, p.name, round(f.ppm, 2) AS ppm, round(f.fixture, 2) AS fixture,
       round(f.picked, 2) AS picked, round(f.fit, 2) AS fit, round(f.points, 2) AS points,
       round(f.plays, 2) AS plays, round(f.expected, 2) AS expected
FROM forecast f JOIN names p USING (player)
WHERE f.run_id = coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM forecast))
  AND p.name LIKE '%' || coalesce(:name, '') || '%' ORDER BY p.name, f.jornada

cash.title: Each manager's cash: yours from the app, rivals' from the ledger (as of now)
cash.sql: SELECT manager, round(cash / 1e6, 2) AS cash_m FROM cash ORDER BY cash DESC

ledger.title: The league's money moves, oldest first; inferred = an exit the feed never recorded
ledger.sql:
SELECT l.at, l.kind, l.who, l.other, coalesce(p.name, l.player) AS player,
       round(l.amount / 1e6, 2) AS amount_m, l.buyer, l.seller, l.inferred
FROM ledger l LEFT JOIN names p ON p.player = l.player
WHERE nullif(:manager, '') IS NULL OR :manager IN (l.who, l.other)
ORDER BY l.at

price_paid.title: What each owner paid for his players (last buy or clause to him)
price_paid.sql:
SELECT o.manager, coalesce(p.name, o.player) AS player, round(pp.paid / 1e6, 2) AS paid_m
FROM owners o LEFT JOIN price_paid pp USING (player)
LEFT JOIN names p ON p.player = o.player
ORDER BY o.manager, pp.paid DESC

price_forecast_error.title: Momentum's price forecasts, refitted each day on what was known then, against what happened (mean abs error, % of value; zero = 'no change')
price_forecast_error.sql:
WITH days AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT day, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY day) - 1 AS r, count(*) OVER () AS m
              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT day FROM price_series WHERE observed_at <= (SELECT cut()))),
daily AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT h, end_day, sxy, sxx FROM momentum_day WHERE ckey = (SELECT ckey FROM k)),
fit AS (SELECT d.day, p.h, sum(p.sxy) / sum(p.sxx) AS slope
        FROM days d JOIN daily p ON p.end_day <= d.day WHERE d.r >= d.m / 4
        GROUP BY d.day, p.h HAVING sum(p.sxx) <> 0),
xs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT day, h, x, change FROM price_ahead
                    WHERE h IN (1, 3, 5) AND end_at <= (SELECT cut())),
pred AS (SELECT f.h, f.slope * x.x AS p, x.change AS act
         FROM fit f JOIN xs x ON x.day = f.day AND x.h = f.h)
SELECT h, count(*) AS n, round(avg(abs(p - act)), 2) AS mae, round(avg(abs(act)), 2) AS zero
FROM pred GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

momentum.title: Price momentum: the slope per horizon and the share of a trend made after each update
momentum.sql: SELECT m.h, round(m.slope, 4) AS slope, round(c.carry, 3) AS carry FROM momentum m LEFT JOIN price_carry c USING (h) ORDER BY m.h

price_trend.title: Each player's expected value change over the horizon, in %
price_trend.sql:
SELECT coalesce(p.name, t.ff_id) AS player, round(t.trend, 1) AS trend_pct FROM price_trend t
LEFT JOIN names p ON p.player = t.ff_id
ORDER BY t.trend DESC

price_change.title: Each player's value change in % over :h updates after his last one on or before :day (all time: what happened)
price_change.sql:
SELECT a.ff_id, coalesce(x.change, 0.0) AS change
FROM (SELECT ff_id, max(i) AS i FROM price_series WHERE day <= :day GROUP BY ff_id) a
LEFT JOIN price_ahead x ON x.ff_id = a.ff_id AND x.i = a.i AND x.h = CAST(:h AS INTEGER)

unmatched_players.title: Players the crosswalk cannot join, the dearest first: with no app id he is never seen as owned, priced or bid on; with no line-up page he has no start odds
unmatched_players.sql:
SELECT c.name, f.owner, round(f.value / 1e6, 2) AS value_m,
       CASE WHEN c.app_id = '' AND c.ff_slug = '' THEN 'neither'
            WHEN c.app_id = '' THEN 'no app id' ELSE 'no line-up page' END AS missing
FROM crosswalk c LEFT JOIN player_facts f ON f.player = c.player_id
WHERE c.app_id = '' OR c.ff_slug = ''
ORDER BY f.value IS NULL, f.value DESC, c.name

constants_vs_measured.title: The constants that have an outcome to be measured against, beside it (latest graded run): PERSISTENT_SHARE against the persistence of the forecast's misses, CONFIDENCE against how often a move that cleared the bar then gained
constants_vs_measured.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) AS run_id),
c AS (SELECT name, value FROM model_constants WHERE variant = (SELECT variant()))
SELECT 'PERSISTENT_SHARE' AS constant, (SELECT value FROM c WHERE name = 'PERSISTENT_SHARE') AS set_to,
       (SELECT persistent_share FROM persistence_by_run JOIN r USING (run_id)) AS measured,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT player) FROM grade_forecast JOIN r USING (run_id)) AS n,
       'share of a player''s miss that repeats the next jornada' AS reading
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CONFIDENCE', (SELECT value FROM c WHERE name = 'CONFIDENCE'),
       round(avg(real > 0), 3), count(*),
       'share of moves that cleared the bar (in the plan or not) that then gained'
FROM grade_decisions JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE reached IN ('plan', 'cleared')

bench_points.title: Each finished jornada (every match scored): the points your fielded eleven scored (the app's line-up at the lock), what sat on your bench, and the best benched player
bench_points.sql:
WITH l AS (SELECT jornada, lock FROM round_locks WHERE jornada IN (SELECT jornada FROM jornadas_done)),
fs AS (SELECT DISTINCT observed_at FROM api_lineup),
fa AS (SELECT l.jornada, (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM fs WHERE observed_at <= l.lock) AS at FROM l),
ts AS (SELECT DISTINCT observed_at FROM api_teams),
ta AS (SELECT l.jornada, (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM ts WHERE observed_at <= l.lock) AS at FROM l),
fielded AS (SELECT DISTINCT fa.jornada, a.player FROM fa
            JOIN api_lineup t ON t.observed_at = fa.at JOIN app_player a ON a.app_id = t.player_id),
squad AS (SELECT DISTINCT ta.jornada, a.player FROM ta
          JOIN api_teams t ON t.observed_at = ta.at AND t.manager = (SELECT me FROM league_config)
          JOIN app_player a ON a.app_id = t.player_id),
pts AS (SELECT player, jornada, sum(pts) AS pts FROM scored GROUP BY player, jornada),
rows AS (SELECT s.jornada, s.player, f.player IS NOT NULL AS in_xi, coalesce(p.pts, 0.0) AS pts
         FROM squad s LEFT JOIN fielded f ON f.jornada = s.jornada AND f.player = s.player
         LEFT JOIN pts p ON p.jornada = s.jornada AND p.player = s.player
         WHERE s.jornada IN (SELECT jornada FROM pts)),
best AS (SELECT jornada, player, pts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jornada ORDER BY pts DESC, player) AS n
         FROM rows WHERE NOT in_xi)
SELECT r.jornada, round(sum(CASE WHEN r.in_xi THEN r.pts END), 0) AS fielded_pts,
       round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN NOT r.in_xi THEN r.pts END), 0), 0) AS bench_pts,
       sum(r.in_xi) AS fielded, n.name AS best_benched, b.pts AS best_benched_pts
FROM rows r LEFT JOIN best b ON b.jornada = r.jornada AND b.n = 1 LEFT JOIN names n ON n.player = b.player
GROUP BY r.jornada ORDER BY r.jornada

rivals.title: Each manager as of the last run: points, expected finish and the chance he ends above you, cash, squad and its value, and what he did in the last 7 days
rivals.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT run_id FROM sim_runs ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1),
v AS (SELECT o.manager, count(*) AS players, total(f.value) AS value
      FROM owners o LEFT JOIN sim_facts f ON f.player = o.player AND f.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM r)
      GROUP BY o.manager),
since AS (SELECT julianday(substr(cut(), 1, 10) || 'T' || substr(cut(), 12, 2) || ':' || substr(cut(), 14, 2) || 'Z') - 7 AS t),
a AS (SELECT buyer AS manager, count(*) AS buys, total(amount) AS spent, 0 AS sells, 0.0 AS got
      FROM ledger WHERE kind IN ('buy', 'clause') AND julianday(at) > (SELECT t FROM since) GROUP BY buyer
      UNION ALL SELECT seller, 0, 0.0, count(*), total(amount)
      FROM ledger WHERE kind IN ('sell', 'clause') AND julianday(at) > (SELECT t FROM since) GROUP BY seller)
SELECT s.manager, s.me, round(s.now) AS points, round(s.mean) AS season_mean, round(s.finish, 2) AS finish,
       round(100 * s.p_above) AS pct_above_you, round(s.cash / 1e6, 1) AS cash_m,
       coalesce(v.players, 0) AS players, round(coalesce(v.value, 0) / 1e6, 1) AS squad_value_m,
       coalesce((SELECT sum(buys) FROM a WHERE a.manager = s.manager), 0) AS buys_7d,
       coalesce((SELECT sum(sells) FROM a WHERE a.manager = s.manager), 0) AS sells_7d,
       round(coalesce((SELECT sum(got - spent) FROM a WHERE a.manager = s.manager), 0) / 1e6, 1) AS net_m_7d
FROM sim_standings s JOIN r USING (run_id) LEFT JOIN v ON v.manager = s.manager
ORDER BY s.mean DESC

what_changed.title: What changed in the forecast between two runs (default: the latest and the last one 12+ hours older) for the next jornada, or :jornada: each player's expected points then and now, and how much of the change is his points when he plays, how likely he is picked, and how likely he is fit (the three add up)
what_changed.sql:
WITH f AS (SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM forecast),
n AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:new, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM f)) AS id),
o AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:old, ''), (
          SELECT max(r.run_id) FROM runs r JOIN f USING (run_id), n
          WHERE r.run_id < n.id AND r.started <= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(
                (SELECT started FROM runs WHERE run_id = n.id), '-12 hours')))) AS id),
j AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:jornada, ''), (SELECT min(jornada) FROM forecast WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM n))) AS j),
a AS (SELECT * FROM forecast WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM o) AND jornada = (SELECT j FROM j)),
b AS (SELECT * FROM forecast WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM n) AND jornada = (SELECT j FROM j))
SELECT nm.name, round(a.expected, 2) AS was, round(b.expected, 2) AS now,
       round(coalesce(b.expected, 0) - coalesce(a.expected, 0), 2) AS change,
       round((b.points - a.points) * a.plays, 2) AS from_points,
       round(b.points * (b.picked - a.picked) * a.fit, 2) AS from_selection,
       round(b.points * b.picked * (b.fit - a.fit), 2) AS from_fitness,
       CASE WHEN a.player IS NULL THEN 'new in the forecast'
            WHEN b.player IS NULL THEN 'gone from the forecast' ELSE 'both' END AS scope
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON b.player = a.player JOIN names nm ON nm.player = coalesce(a.player, b.player)
WHERE abs(coalesce(b.expected, 0) - coalesce(a.expected, 0)) > 0.005
ORDER BY abs(coalesce(b.expected, 0) - coalesce(a.expected, 0)) DESC, nm.name

cash_cliffs.title: Managers below zero at the last run (rival cash is estimated from the feed): what each must raise before the lock, his squad's value, and the fewest sales that could do it, selling his most valuable first. Which players he sells is not forecast: that needs the simulation (season points alone ranked my own squad's sales wrongly, 155 points against the plan's 35)
cash_cliffs.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT max(run_id) AS run_id FROM sim_runs),
m AS (SELECT manager, -cash AS debt FROM sim_standings JOIN r USING (run_id) WHERE cash < 0),
squad AS (SELECT m.manager, m.debt, o.player, f.value
          FROM m JOIN owners o ON o.manager = m.manager
          JOIN sim_facts f ON f.player = o.player AND f.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM r) WHERE f.value > 0),
run AS (SELECT *, sum(value) OVER (PARTITION BY manager ORDER BY value DESC, player) AS cum FROM squad)
SELECT manager, round(debt / 1e6, 1) AS debt_m, round(total(value) / 1e6, 1) AS squad_value_m,
       count(*) AS players, sum(cum - value < debt) AS fewest_sales
FROM run GROUP BY manager ORDER BY debt DESC, manager

paired_gain.title: Is one run's forecast better than another's? The same player-jornadas forecast by both (:old, :new, default the first and latest graded run; :ahead jornadas past the lock it was forecast from, default 0: the next jornada), the mean squared-error gain of the new over the old with its standard error and a 95% interval, for all, flagged and not flagged players. A gain is only established when the interval excludes zero (outcomes treated as independent, which flatters the interval a little)
paired_gain.sql:
WITH ids AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:new, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) AS new,
                    coalesce(nullif(:old, ''), (SELECT min(run_id) FROM grade_forecast)) AS old,
                    cast(coalesce(nullif(:ahead, ''), 0) AS INTEGER) AS ahead),
d AS (SELECT n.flagged,
             (o.predicted - o.actual) * (o.predicted - o.actual)
           - (n.predicted - n.actual) * (n.predicted - n.actual) AS d
      FROM grade_forecast n JOIN grade_forecast o USING (from_j, jornada, player), ids
      WHERE n.run_id = ids.new AND o.run_id = ids.old AND n.jornada - n.from_j = ids.ahead),
s AS (SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(*) AS n, avg(d) AS gain,
             (sum(d * d) - count(*) * avg(d) * avg(d)) / (count(*) - 1) AS var FROM d
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'flagged', count(*), avg(d), (sum(d * d) - count(*) * avg(d) * avg(d)) / (count(*) - 1) FROM d WHERE flagged = 1
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'not flagged', count(*), avg(d), (sum(d * d) - count(*) * avg(d) * avg(d)) / (count(*) - 1) FROM d WHERE flagged = 0),
t AS (SELECT scope, n, gain, sqrt(max(var, 0) / n) AS se FROM s WHERE n > 0)
SELECT scope, n, round(gain, 4) AS gain, round(se, 4) AS se,
       round(lo95(gain, se), 4) AS lo, round(hi95(gain, se), 4) AS hi,
       CASE claim(gain, se) WHEN 'positive' THEN 'new better' WHEN 'negative' THEN 'old better'
            ELSE claim(gain, se) END AS verdict
FROM t ORDER BY CASE scope WHEN 'all' THEN 0 WHEN 'flagged' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

replay_by_lead.title: Forecast error against how far from the lock it was made (the next jornada replayed at every line-up snapshot, python src/grading.py replay): outcomes, moments, rmse, bias and the flagged players' rmse per lead bucket. Buckets hold different jornadas, so read replay_gap for what earlier costs (:variant, default live)
replay_by_lead.sql: SELECT variant, lead, n, moments, round(rmse, 3) AS rmse, round(bias, 3) AS bias, round(flagged_rmse, 3) AS flagged_rmse FROM replay_lead WHERE variant = coalesce(nullif(:variant, ''), 'live') ORDER BY variant, from_h

replay_gap.title: What forecasting earlier costs: the same player-jornadas forecast at each lead and at the jornada's last replayed moment; the mean squared error earlier minus last (positive: earlier is worse) with a 95% interval. The interval treats a player's repeats across moments as independent, so it is narrower than the truth; trust the pattern across leads, not an edge (:variant, default live)
replay_gap.sql: SELECT variant, lead, scope, n, round(extra_mse, 3) AS extra_mse, round(se, 3) AS se, round(lo, 3) AS lo, round(hi, 3) AS hi, claim FROM replay_gap WHERE variant = coalesce(nullif(:variant, ''), 'live') ORDER BY variant, from_h, scope DESC

variant_gap.title: Is a challenger better than live? The two variants' replayed forecasts (:old, :new; set up with python src/grading.py variant, replayed with LFG_VARIANT=name ... replay) of each jornada at its last moment at least :hours (default 24) before the lock, the same player-jornadas: mean squared-error gain of :new over :old with a 95% interval (positive: :new is better), for all, flagged and not flagged players. One moment a jornada, so the outcomes are not repeated
variant_gap.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:old, ''), 'live') AS old, :new AS new,
             cast(coalesce(nullif(:hours, ''), 24) AS REAL) AS hours),
pairs AS (SELECT o.as_of, o.jornada, o.flagged, o.lead_h,
                 (o.predicted - o.actual) * (o.predicted - o.actual)
               - (n.predicted - n.actual) * (n.predicted - n.actual) AS d
          FROM replay_forecast o JOIN replay_forecast n
            ON n.as_of = o.as_of AND n.jornada = o.jornada AND n.player = o.player, a
          WHERE o.variant = a.old AND n.variant = a.new),
last AS (SELECT jornada, max(as_of) AS as_of FROM pairs, a WHERE lead_h >= a.hours GROUP BY jornada),
d AS (SELECT p.flagged, p.d FROM pairs p JOIN last l ON l.as_of = p.as_of AND l.jornada = p.jornada),
s AS (SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(*) AS n, avg(d) AS gain,
             (sum(d * d) - count(*) * avg(d) * avg(d)) / (count(*) - 1) AS var FROM d
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'flagged', count(*), avg(d), (sum(d * d) - count(*) * avg(d) * avg(d)) / (count(*) - 1) FROM d WHERE flagged = 1
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'not flagged', count(*), avg(d), (sum(d * d) - count(*) * avg(d) * avg(d)) / (count(*) - 1) FROM d WHERE flagged = 0),
t AS (SELECT scope, n, gain, sqrt(max(var, 0) / n) AS se FROM s WHERE n > 0)
SELECT scope, n, round(gain, 4) AS gain, round(se, 4) AS se,
       round(lo95(gain, se), 4) AS lo, round(hi95(gain, se), 4) AS hi,
       CASE claim(gain, se) WHEN 'positive' THEN 'new better' WHEN 'negative' THEN 'old better'
            ELSE claim(gain, se) END AS verdict
FROM t ORDER BY CASE scope WHEN 'all' THEN 0 WHEN 'flagged' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

phantom_coach.title: The phantom manager (:run, default the latest graded): your squad at the first lock, then at each lock the plan this code makes for the squad and cash he has, his eleven picked from that lock's forecast and scored on what they got, jornada by jornada, beside the same squad never moved and picked the same way. gain = phantom minus never moved. Bids win at the model's price and rivals do not react; the code was written knowing these weeks, so read a gain as an upper bound
phantom_coach.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM phantom_jornadas)) AS run_id),
j AS (SELECT p.jornada, p.phantom, p.standpat, p.phantom - p.standpat AS gain, p.moves, p.cash,
             row_number() OVER (ORDER BY p.jornada) AS n
      FROM phantom_jornadas p, r WHERE p.run_id = r.run_id)
SELECT jornada, phantom, standpat, gain, total_gain, moves FROM (
  SELECT jornada, phantom, standpat, gain, sum(gain) OVER (ORDER BY n) AS total_gain, moves, 0 AS tail FROM j
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'total', sum(phantom), sum(standpat), sum(gain), sum(gain), '', 1 FROM j)
ORDER BY tail, jornada

rival_boards.title: What each rival's board would do for him (:run, default the latest that has them): the same funnel with him as the manager, his cash our estimate and his pending bids invisible to us. His cash, what his plan gains over the season in points, and his planned moves in order
rival_boards.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM rival_boards)) AS run_id)
SELECT b.manager, round(b.cash / 1e6, 1) AS cash_m, round(b.plan_gain, 1) AS plan_gain,
       (SELECT group_concat(label, '; ') FROM (SELECT label FROM rival_moves m
                                               WHERE m.run_id = b.run_id AND m.manager = b.manager ORDER BY ord)) AS moves
FROM rival_boards b, r WHERE b.run_id = r.run_id ORDER BY b.plan_gain DESC

board_history.title: How long each move stayed on the published board (boards since 2026-09-27, from git; earlier shapes stay in git): the boards it was on, first and last seen, its average points gain, and whether it is on the latest board
board_history.sql:
SELECT m.what, m.name, count(*) AS boards, min(m.generated_at) AS first_seen, max(m.generated_at) AS last_seen,
       round(avg(m.gain), 1) AS avg_gain,
       max(m.generated_at) = (SELECT max(generated_at) FROM board_history) AS on_latest
FROM board_history_moves m WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.what, m.name ORDER BY boards DESC, m.name

sim_calibration.title: Is the standings forecast's spread right? Each manager's points in a clean jornada against the forecast of it at the lock (its mean and spread) (:run, default the latest graded): outcomes, how many fell inside the 10-90 and 25-75 bands (want 80% and 50%), and the mean and spread of z = (actual - model mean) / model sd (want 0 and 1). 'totals' are single managers' points, which a league-wide jornada shock moves together; 'you minus him' is the difference, what who-finishes-above rests on. Outcomes within a jornada are correlated, so read a dozen jornadas, not the first few
sim_calibration.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT coalesce(nullif(:run, ''), (SELECT max(run_id) FROM sim_calibration)) AS run_id),
x AS (SELECT 'totals' AS scope, jornada, pit, (actual - mean) / sd AS z FROM sim_calibration, r WHERE sim_calibration.run_id = r.run_id AND sd > 0
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'you minus him', jornada, diff_pit, (diff_actual - diff_mean) / diff_sd FROM sim_calibration, r
      WHERE sim_calibration.run_id = r.run_id AND diff_sd > 0)
SELECT scope, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT jornada) AS jornadas,
       round(avg(pit > 0.1 AND pit < 0.9), 2) AS in_10_90, round(avg(pit > 0.25 AND pit < 0.75), 2) AS in_25_75,
       round(avg(z), 2) AS z_mean,
       round(sqrt((sum(z * z) - count(*) * avg(z) * avg(z)) / (count(*) - 1)), 2) AS z_sd
FROM x GROUP BY scope ORDER BY scope DESC
